shared_elements: carved/incised marks on a flat stone surface
a roughly horizontal row or cluster of small repeated marks
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces bear incised marks that seem to line up in a rough horizontal row of small repeated units, which is about as generic as carved marking gets. A is a dense, fully ordered grid of ornate rectangular sign-blocks packed with faces, eyes, curls and internal infill, while B shows only a sparse, faint cluster of plain linear strokes with no recognisable figural or compartmentalised structure.
